name: Dream of Darkness
source:
1518, somewhere in the Atlantic Ocean. A Spanish explorer leads his company to the New World amid strange reports of a ghost island.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]

1518年，大西洋某处。一位西班牙探险家带着他的同伴前往新世界，听到了有关鬼岛的奇怪报道。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
